title: Compatible perfect matching in a multipartite graph
statement: Let $q,k$ be natural numbers, and label the vertices of the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part by elements of a type $\beta$. Suppose the labeling is injective on each part, and every label has an even number of vertices carrying it. Then the graph has a perfect matching in which the two endpoints of every matched edge have the same label.
hypotheses_covered: A labeling of the vertices by elements of $\beta$ is given
The labeling is injective within each part
Every label has an even number of vertices carrying it
